description:
Update the exterior wall and roof construction thermal properties in the 4StoreyBuilding eQUEST model to reflect an insulation upgrade retrofit. 

1. Navigate to Building Shell > Constructions.
2. Locate 'EWall Construction' and change its properties to use a U-VALUE of 0.048 (representing R-13 + R-7.5 ci).
3. Locate 'Roof Construction' and change its properties to use a U-VALUE of 0.033 (representing R-30).
4. Run the full annual simulation (Actions > Simulate Building Performance).
5. Save the project.

The task starts with eQUEST open. You must locate the constructions in the Component Tree and apply the changes.
